BrochureContent.Content:
GVM are delighted to bring to the market this hugely impressive two storey executive style 5-bedroom detached home situated in one of Limerick`s finest locations. No. 12 is a bright, spacious, and beautifully presented property positioned in this exclusive enclave of all modern detached houses nestling in a leafy and established cul de sac and not overlooked at the rear. This is truly a wonderful opportunity to acquire a beautifully maintained home that boasts well-proportioned living and bedroom accommodation. The ground floor features an inviting hallway, a generous lounge, sitting room, an open-plan kitchen/dining area with a sun-drenched sunroom off, utility room, and a downstairs guest wc, whb. Upstairs, there are five spacious bedrooms (two en suite) together with a fully fitted and beautifully tiled main bathroom. Gas fired central heating system. Double glazed UPVC windows. Beautifully appointed patio area and flower beds in rear garden blended with shrubbery and meticulously maintained and well-manicured lawns. Good views to the rear.

Notwithstanding the exclusivity of this magnificent development, this wonderful home is located in close proximity and within walking distance to University of Limerick, Plassey Technological Park, Castletroy Shopping Centre, Castletroy Golf Club, Newtown Recreation Park, Castletroy College, Primary Schools, The Greenway and an array of top-class sporting amenities and clubs including Monaleen GAA Club, UL Bohs RFC and Aishling Annacotty FC. There is also very easy access also to the nearby Motorway providing good connectivity to our national road network. Large storage attic area partially floored. Mature and very spacious site with excellent off-street parking in a cobbled driveway to the front. Excellent BER rating (B3). Security alarm. Must be seen to be appreciated.

This is truly a wonderful opportunity to acquire a beautifully maintained home that really oozes location location location. Inspection is very highly recommended.
